title: Start-from-Scratch Reconstruction of Challenging Objects with Local-Orbital Ptychography
content: With the advancement of aberration-corrected transmission electron microscopy, spatial resolution has reached the sub-angstrom scale. As a sophisticated computational imaging technique, ptychography has gained significant attention in recent years [1-5]. This method utilizes 4D-STEM datasets and specialized imaging algorithms to extract structural information from objects. Owing to its substantial advantages over other techniques, ptychography has been increasingly employed to achieve ultra-high-resolution imaging, setting the highest reported spatial resolution information limit in microscopic imaging [6].
